reports.title: Guy Scotchford: Prevention of future deaths report
reports.area: Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly

promises.quote: The government is committed to delivering a renewed drive to tackle the number of lives lost to suicide. Cross-government action is key in achieving this, and coordinated action is taking place across government to enable us to rapidly identify and proactively tackle emerging methods of suicide as quickly and effectively as possible, with a series of interventions to reduce access and awareness of dangerous methods.
promises.summary: Launch coordinated cross-government action to reduce access to dangerous suicide methods.
promises.timescale: as quickly and effectively as possible

reports.title: Rhiannon Williams: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

concerns.quote: Rhiannon accessed an online 'suicide forum' where she was able to access information on how to take her own life and where she obtained advice/information on misleading professionals and her family as to her thoughts and intentions. Rhiannon also accessed a social media platform to obtain information about the method Rhiannon used to take her own life.
concerns.hazard: access to suicide forums and social media platforms providing instructions on self-harm

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the danger of individuals obtaining suicide‑method information through online sources.
